spans.s: AF1331 नत ग्रीवा nata grīvā Forward bending of the neck
SV0169 नातिद्रुतं nātidrutaṁ One should not eat food in hurry; it may leads to food improper mixing of food with saliva, indigestion and entry of food in wrong tract.
SV0170 नातिविलम्बितम् nātivilambitam One should not eat too slow by this one doesn't get satisfaction, eats more, food becomes cold and is digested irregularly.
